test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 03 Dec, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people - A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of D. B sits second to the left of Z. Y sits third to the left of A. Only one person sits to the right of X. Who among the following sits at the second position from the left?
solution: Given: Seven people - A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 1) Only two people sit to the left of D. 2) Only one person sits to the right of X. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4411499c7034192b84142763b88e6a18ea288dfa314a6115f6d171818f933ee5.png] 3) B sits second to the left of Z.
